user.title: Auckland Transport
user.description: Pick an API key that is already configured, or enter a new one.

new_api_key.title: Enter your API key
new_api_key.description: Sign up for a free Auckland Transport subscription key at https://dev-portal.at.govt.nz/signup and subscribe to the GTFS and Realtime APIs.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your API key
reauth_confirm.description: Auckland Transport rejected the stored key. Enter a valid one; every stop using the old key will be updated.

stop_filter.title: Find your stop
stop_filter.description: {total} stops are published in the current timetable. Filter by mode and search by stop name or stop code.

data_description.search: Part of the stop name, or the stop code printed on the sign.
data_description.include_platforms: Off by default. A station covers all of its platforms in one entity and reports the platform per departure, which is usually what you want.

error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Check it is subscribed to both the GTFS and Realtime APIs.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Auckland Transport API.
error.no_stops_found: No stops matched. Go back and widen the search.

init.title: Auckland Transport options
init.description: Realtime data refreshes every 60 seconds using a single shared API call, no matter how many stops you have configured, and timetables are downloaded once per stop per day. The main sensor always carries the next 40 departures.

data.hide_arrivals: Hide services that only drop off

data_description.departure_sensors: Creates sensor.…_departure_1 through _departure_N, each holding the full detail of one departure. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.hide_arrivals: Some trips terminate at your stop and cannot be boarded.
data_description.include_school_buses: School routes are the S-prefixed services.
data_description.only_active_alerts: Auckland Transport publishes alerts weeks in advance; turning this off shows those too.
data_description.legacy_attributes: Keeps the flat departure_1_* attributes that version 0.2 of the Lovelace card reads. Leave on unless you have upgraded the card.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force an immediate refresh of every configured stop.

reload_static_data.name: Reload static data
reload_static_data.description: Re-download the GTFS stop and route lists and discard cached timetables.
